newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo unit aims for 18 pct sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo unit aims for 18 pct sales rise.

text.p: Daewoo Corp, a unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Tuesday its trading arm had set its calendar 1997 sales target at 18.3 trillion won, up about 18 percent from 1996.
Daewoo said in a statement it was targeting export sales of $15 billion, up 14.5 percent from 1996.
The statement said total sales of its trading arm were estimated at 15.5 trillion won in 1996, up 26 percent from 1995, including exports worth $13.1 billion, up 23 percent.
South Korean companies with their fiscal year ending in December usually release their annual income statements between February and March the next year.
